def search_all_simple(query, page_limit=20):
    out=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        out.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
        if len(page) < page_limit:
            break
    return out

# Parse employers list and prepare individualized email bodies

# Ensure required variables exist from earlier steps
print('has employers_note', 'employers_note' in globals())
print('has template_note', 'template_note' in globals())

if 'employers_note' not in globals():
    raise RuntimeError('employers_note missing')
if 'template_note' not in globals():
    raise RuntimeError('template_note missing')

template = template_note['content']
employers_content = employers_note['content']
print('template first 200 chars:\n', template[:200])
print('employers_content first 200 chars:\n', employers_content[:200])
print('employers_content length', len(employers_content))

lines = [ln.strip() for ln in employers_content.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
print('non-empty lines', len(lines))

# Extract pairs of company and email from lines containing '--'
import re
pairs=[]
for ln in lines:
    if '--' not in ln:
        continue
    # expected format: Company Name -- email
    parts = [p.strip() for p in ln.split('--', 1)]
    if len(parts)!=2:
        continue
    company, email = parts
    email=email.strip()
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+", email, flags=re.IGNORECASE):
        continue
    pairs.append((company, email))

print('extracted pairs', len(pairs))
print('pairs:', pairs)

# Prepare email bodies using template placeholder {company_name}
prepared=[]
for company, email in pairs:
    body = template.replace('{company_name}', company)
    prepared.append({'company_name': company, 'email': email, 'body': body})

print('prepared count', len(prepared))
print('sample for first:', prepared[0]['company_name'], prepared[0]['email'])
print('body first 150 chars:\n', prepared[0]['body'][:150])

import os, re

# Ensure tokens exist; if not, login
super_pw = {p['account_name']: p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}

if 'file_token' not in globals() or not file_token:
    file_token = apis.file_system.login(username='ad.blackburn@gmail.com', password=super_pw['file_system'])['access_token']
    print('logged into file_system')
else:
    print('using existing file_token')

if 'gmail_token' not in globals() or not gmail_token:
    gmail_token = apis.gmail.login(username='ad.blackburn@gmail.com', password=super_pw['gmail'])['access_token']
    print('logged into gmail')
else:
    print('using existing gmail_token')

# Find CV file(s) in ~/documents/work/ matching 'cv' (not recursive)
work_dir = '~/documents/work/'
files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=file_token, directory_path=work_dir, entry_type='files', recursive=False)
print('work_dir direct files count', len(files))
print('work_dir direct files', files)

# Prefer files whose basename includes 'cv'
cv_candidates = []
for p in files:
    base = os.path.basename(p).lower()
    if 'cv' in base:
        cv_candidates.append(p)
print('cv_candidates', cv_candidates)

# If none, fall back to any file in recursive listing with 'cv'
if not cv_candidates:
    all_files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=file_token, directory_path=work_dir, entry_type='files', recursive=True)
    for p in all_files:
        base = os.path.basename(p).lower()
        if 'cv' in base:
            cv_candidates.append(p)
    print('fallback cv_candidates', cv_candidates)

# Choose first candidate sorted for determinism
cv_candidates_sorted = sorted(cv_candidates)
cv_path = cv_candidates_sorted[0] if cv_candidates_sorted else None

# reuse prepared from earlier if present; otherwise reconstruct
if 'prepared' not in globals() or not prepared:

    employers_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3085, access_token=apis.simple_note.login(username='ad.blackburn@gmail.com', password=super_pw['simple_note'])['access_token'])
    template = template_note['content']
    employers_content = employers_note['content']
    lines = [ln.strip() for ln in employers_content.splitlines() if ln.strip()]

    for ln in lines:
        if '--' not in ln:
            continue
        company, email = [p.strip() for p in ln.split('--',1)]
        if re.fullmatch(r"[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+", email, flags=re.IGNORECASE):
            pairs.append((company, email))
    prepared=[{'company_name':company,'email':email,'body':template.replace('{company_name}',company)} for company,email in pairs]

print('sending to', len(prepared), 'recipients')

send_results=[]
for item in prepared:
    recipient_email = item['email']
    body = item['body']
    # call send_email for single recipient
    res = apis.gmail.send_email(
        access_token=gmail_token,
        email_addresses=[recipient_email],
        subject=subject,
        body=body,
        attachment_file_paths=[cv_path],
        file_system_access_token=file_token
    )
    send_results.append({'recipient': recipient_email, 'res': res})
    print('sent to', recipient_email, '->', res)
